description: Synthetic normalized inputs and manually authored exact results. Proposed contract, not shipped repository behavior.

conventions.rateExact: Reduced rational string: scale * numerator / denominator; null means unavailable.
conventions.observedNumerator: Sum of valid observed numerator contributions; null if source unavailable. It is not a completeness claim.
conventions.numerator: Full requested-scope numerator; null if collection incomplete/unverified, source unavailable, or any required numerator invalid.
conventions.coverage: Explicit author/source declaration for this fixture's exact scope. Absence of events never establishes coverage.
conventions.membership: References are (sourceId,rowId), ordered in source order except stable collapse representation ordered by row ID.
conventions.duplicatePolicy: Unique by default. Collapse/extraction are explicit later-stage behaviors; one representative contributes, all equivalent rows remain evidence.
conventions.pooling: Same-window disjoint region populations only; requested selected groups are never silently dropped.
conventions.countValidity: Event-count numerators are finite, nonnegative integers no greater than 2^53-1; fractional/weighted amounts require a different declared feature.
conventions.unattributedEvents: An invalid/missing region key in or possibly in the requested window blocks every possibly affected requested group. Preserve global orphan evidence; a known unmatched key belongs to its own group.
conventions.unrelatedDenominatorRows: Other-period or other-scope rows are traced exclusions if an exact requested-grain row exists; they are not duplicates of that grain.
